articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a larger context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap with specialized domain models. Enterprise API pricing introduces a new tiered compute model based on reasoning depth.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with a focus on autonomous agent capabilities, showing leading performance on real-world web navigation, tool-use orchestration, and multi-app workflow benchmarks. The model integrates a persistent memory layer enabling long-running task execution across sessions. Google is positioning it as the backbone for a new generation of Workspace AI agents shipping later this quarter.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 03 humanoid robots have entered full commercial deployment at two BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina, performing parts inspection, kitting, and light assembly tasks alongside human workers. The robots operate autonomously for 18-hour shifts with a reported 97.3% task completion rate. This marks one of the first large-scale paid commercial humanoid deployments in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Dexterous Object Manipulation and Unsupervised Learning
articles.summary: Tesla showcased the third-generation Optimus humanoid performing complex bimanual manipulation tasks including folding laundry, sorting irregularly shaped objects, and operating power tools, driven by a new vision-language-action model trained on fleet teleoperation data. Musk indicated that limited external sales would begin in Q4 2026. The sim-to-real transfer pipeline reportedly cuts new skill training time to under 48 hours.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 with Verified Reasoning Chains and Alignment Transparency
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude 4 featuring interpretable reasoning traces that allow developers to audit the model's chain-of-thought for faithfulness and detect hallucinated logic steps. A new Constitutional AI v3 framework provides fine-grained steerability over safety-capability tradeoffs. Early benchmarks show it competing directly with GPT-5 on coding and mathematical reasoning while offering meaningfully lower confabulation rates on factual recall tasks.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed the start of volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process technology using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors at its Kaohsiung fab. The node delivers approximately 25% performance improvement and 35% power reduction over N2, targeting AI accelerator and mobile SoC applications. Apple and NVIDIA are reported to be among the first customers taping out designs on the new node.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on 12 logical qubits with error rates below the threshold required for practical quantum error correction, using Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion system and Microsoft's topological qubit decoding software. The demonstration ran a simplified quantum chemistry simulation that would be intractable classically. This milestone advances the timeline for commercially useful quantum computation significantly.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Operates Fully Autonomously in Unstructured Disaster Environments
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released field trial results showing its electric Atlas humanoid navigating collapsed building environments, climbing rubble, and performing search-and-rescue object retrieval tasks fully autonomously for up to 4 hours without operator intervention. The system uses a foundation world model trained on photorealistic simulation to generalize locomotion across novel terrain. FEMA has initiated a pilot program to evaluate deployment at future disaster sites.
